title: test_chart_validate marks its rows as testing and leaves none in the live cairn tables
intention: test_chart_validate.py folds a per-run id marked as testing into every row it writes to the live cairn tables, and removes that run's nodes, embeddings and links in a finally block, so a run leaves no row behind and two copies at once do not collide.
why: Measured 2026-11-20: 317 nodes and 317 embeddings from this proof's runs stand in the live cairn_nodes and cairn_embeddings, none marked as testing, because its scratch nexus drops only the leaf table. Proof rows in the live corpus are indistinguishable from real ones to every reader of the trees.
traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured: a proof's rows in the live corpus are measurements of nothing, read as real); Law 9 (green is earned: a proof that leaves residue is not clean green).
how: Rides e4fd7f28faaf: once a test run's writes reach cairn_testing by construction (outline 4.3.1.5.1.5.2, the runner sets the context, never the proof), cairn/devices/codemother/machines/validate/proofs/test_chart_validate.py needs no mark-and-clean code, and this ticket writes none. Its build is the red-first proof cairn/devices/codemother/machines/validate/proofs/test_chart_validate_runs_alongside_itself.py: it runs two copies of test_chart_validate.py at once and reads the live cairn_nodes, cairn_embeddings and cairn_links counts before and after. It is red today (the rows land in live) and turns green when e4fd7f28faaf lands, with no change to test_chart_validate.py. If it stays red after e4fd7f28faaf, what remains is this ticket's finding. RULE 1: it measures only codemother's own proof.

clauses.claim: two copies of test_chart_validate.py run at the same time, both exit 0 with no FAIL tooth
across a run of test_chart_validate.py, the live cairn_nodes, cairn_embeddings and cairn_links counts, read from the live database, are unchanged: zero rows left in live
one copy of test_chart_validate.py run alone still exits 0

decisions.text: D1: no change to test_chart_validate.py: no run id, no testing marker, no finally-block cleanup. The isolation is e4fd7f28faaf's, by construction.
D2: the red-first proof runs two copies at once and counts rows before and after, one tooth per clause.

out: cairn/devices/codemother/machines/validate/proofs/test_chart_validate.py itself (it rides e4fd7f28faaf; no mark-and-clean code is written)
e4fd7f28faaf's store door (cairn/devices/db_domain), its own ticket
the 317 rows already in the tables (not deleted or attributed here)
the other codemother proofs and test_librarian_trees.py (their own tickets)

measured.saw: Read-only SELECT on the live cairn db (akiendelllinux): 317 rows in cairn_nodes with provenance under a chart_validate_proof_ scratch dir (144 since 2026-10-03), latest 2026-11-19 22:42; content prefix 'accept the alpha work' counts the same 317; the same count in cairn_embeddings; 0 carry any testing marker in provenance. Each content ends '[<nexus>]', the run's scratch nexus name, so runs do not collide, but every run's rows stay.
measured.how: SELECT count(*), max(created) FROM cairn_nodes / cairn_embeddings WHERE provenance LIKE '%chart_validate_proof_%' (and by content prefix), on a read-only session; nothing run against live

measured.saw: cairn/devices/codemother/machines/validate/proofs/test_chart_validate.py line 303: trees.deposit writes the node to cairn_nodes and the embedding to cairn_embeddings, shared and live, and only the leaf to the run's scratch nexus (validate, via tree.scratch_nexus). scratch_nexus drops only the leaf table at exit, and the proof never calls trees.forget_leaf.
